name: GhostPortal
description: Thin SSR-safe wrapper around Vue Teleport for rendering overlay content outside the parent DOM hierarchy. Defers teleportation until after mount so SSR and initial hydration render inline without touching document.

props.name: defer
props.description: Defer target lookup until after the current mount or update cycle so targets rendered later in the tree resolve.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Render slot content inline instead of teleporting.

props.name: to
props.description: Target CSS selector, DOM element, or null (disables teleportation) to teleport children into after mount.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Overlay content to teleport to the target container once mounted (or render inline when disabled or during SSR).
